symptom: describe page printed a Studio Pro expression parameter as written, `ContentParams: ({1} = $currentObject/CollectionIdentifierLabel)`, and check refused it: "a template parameter is evaluated against the widget's own context object … Write \"CollectionIdentifierLabel\"" [MDL-WIDGET24] (mendixlabs/mxcli#1406).
cause: The writer (isTemplateExpression) read a `$var/Attr` path as an attribute binding and kept the prefix in the attribute name (CE1613, #1046); MDL-WIDGET24 was added to refuse the spelling rather than fix the write. Studio Pro stores exactly that text as Forms$ClientTemplateParameter.Expression, so describe was right and the writer/check pair was wrong.
insight: When describe and check disagree, ask what Studio Pro stores before picking a side: here the stored value was an Expression, so the only spelling that re-creates the same model is the expression itself, and the fix belongs in the writer. A check rule that refuses a spelling because the writer mishandles it is a symptom patch that later blocks round-trip. Measured on 11.6.6: Expression `$currentObject/Name` and `$EntA/Name` build at 0 errors; over a Decimal it is CE0117 (an expression parameter must be a String), a user error the no-project check can no longer see. `$currentObject/Assoc/Attr` stays an association binding (#1046 measured it clean).
